newsitem.title: USA: Thermo Ecotek has Czech power plant option.
newsitem.headline: Thermo Ecotek has Czech power plant option.

text.p: Thermo Ecotek Corp said its Thermo EuroVentures subsidiary has an option to finance and develop a 30-megawatt natural gas-fired, combined-cycle power plant in the town of Pribram, Czech Republic.
The Pribram II Cogeneration Project will be an add-on to an existing 36-MW coal-fired heating plant previously developed by EMD Pribram, which granted the option.

The agreement with EMD Pribram gives Thermo EuroVentures the exclusive right to provide 100 percent of the project's equity or subordinated debt requirements, and includes a buyout provision under which Thermo EuroVentures could acquire the entire project within three years after the start of commercial operations, Thermo Ecotek said.
Construction financing for the project is expected to close in 1997, with commercial operations slated to begin in 1999.

Thermo EuroVentures signed a joint development agreement with EMD in January 1996 to pursue power projects in the Czech Republic. Pribram II would be the first project to be developed under the agreement. Thermo Ecotek is a public subsidiary of Thermo Electron Corp.
